post_title: How to make font size bigger in pattern view
post_details: I couldn't find a setting to change the font size in the pattern view. Is that possible? It's independent from zoom level. It's just so tiny.
post_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide on how to increase the font size in pattern view for enhanced readability.

comments.comment_body: Hello 901995456466, Thank you for contacting us! Unfortunately, we do not provide the feature of resizing the font size for now. However, you may try this. You can change the resolution according to your system specification in the user settings. The overall size of the program would be adjusted. Location: Settings &gt User Settings &gt User Interface &gt Display &gt Resolution. I hope this information helps you. Have a lovely day! Should have further questions, please let us know :)
